# Yating Chatiron

> Cybersecurity specialist for healthcare & medical infrastructure, and DevOps/Cloud Infrastructure Engineer (Kubernetes, GitOps, multi-cloud). President of Taiwan Tech France, the Taiwanese tech community in France.

Yating Chatiron is a cybersecurity and cloud infrastructure engineer specializing in healthcare and medical systems, combining hands-on pentesting, Kubernetes security, and multi-cloud engineering (AWS, GCP, Azure) to secure infrastructure for the health sector. This site is a personal portfolio and technical blog, published in English and French, sharing write-ups on cloud security, DevOps practice, and infrastructure engineering. She is also President of Taiwan Tech France (TTF), the association for Taiwanese tech professionals in France.

## Key Information

- **Website**: https://tesshsu.github.io/
- **Role**: DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure Engineer — Healthcare & Medical Sector Specialist
- **Cybersecurity focus**: Pentesting, Kubernetes/cloud-native security, infrastructure security for healthcare systems
- **Focus areas**: Infrastructure as Code, Kubernetes & GitOps, Multi-Cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure), Cloud & Cyber Security
- **Community role**: President, Taiwan Tech France (TTF) — https://ttf-tech.github.io/
- **Language Support**: English (primary site), Français (blog posts, `fr.html`)
- **Freelance side mission**: Smart Locker & LCM advisory — La Réunion

## Specialization: Cybersecurity for Healthcare & Medical Infrastructure

Yating focuses on securing infrastructure for healthcare and medical systems, at the intersection of cloud engineering and cybersecurity:

- Certified in Kubernetes and Cloud Native Security (KCSA — CNCF/Linux Foundation) and Cyber Sécurité Pentesting (NRS6092).
- Regularly writes and publishes under the **Cyber** category on her blog — pentesting methodology, vulnerability research (e.g. Linux kernel flaws), hash/cryptography fundamentals, and threat actor analysis (e.g. MirrorFace/APT10).
- Applies DevOps & cloud-native security practices (zero trust, IAM, infrastructure-as-code hardening) to healthcare-sector infrastructure specifically, not just general enterprise IT.

Relevant posts: see the **Cyber** category on the [Blog](https://tesshsu.github.io/blog.html), or browse [sitemap.xml](https://tesshsu.github.io/sitemap.xml) for the full archive.

## Community Leadership

**President, Taiwan Tech France (TTF)** · 在法臺灣科技社群 · Communauté tech taïwanaise en France

Pour les ingénieurs et professionnels tech taïwanais en France — partager des opportunités, rencontrer des pairs, évoluer ensemble.

- [Taiwan Tech France](https://ttf-tech.github.io/): Association (Loi 1901) for Taiwanese tech professionals, freelancers, and students in France — career networking, job referrals, and technical exchange.
